title: GenWave Ad Pack Manifest
description: The <slug>.ad-pack.json shape a GenWave station fetches for a kind:"ad-pack" catalog entry (app repo SPEC F162.2, GenWave.Host.Catalog.CatalogAdPackManifestSerializer — the canonical reader this schema mirrors). DATA ONLY: an optional, decorative `packName` plus `briefs[]` — brand briefs the station's OWN LLM writes parody spots FROM (a fictional brand, and optional premise/tone/structure hints). No script, no audio, no code ever crosses this trust boundary; every installed brief still faces the app's AdScriptValidator (blocklisted real brands, 555 phone shape, audience posture) at generation time, exactly like an owner-typed one. The caps below mirror the serializer's own constants verbatim: 1–100 briefs per pack (MaxBriefsPerPack), brand 1–200 chars (MaxBrandLength), each hint ≤ 500 chars (MaxHintLength). additionalProperties is false at both levels — the app's reader silently ignores an unknown member, so a misspelled `premise` would install as a brief with no premise at all; failing CI here is the honest outcome. What JSON Schema cannot express — two briefs in one pack sharing a brand after case/whitespace folding (the app upserts keyed (pack_slug, brand) inside one transaction, so the later one silently overwrites the earlier; a case-only variant would list as two brands) — is tools/validate.py's validate_ad_pack.
$comment: `brand`'s pattern is a bare \S — an unanchored search for one non-whitespace character, i.e. the serializer's own non-blank rule (a whitespace-only brand folds to null there and fails the whole manifest). No end anchor is needed for a search pattern, so the (?![\s\S]) idiom the other schemas document does not appear here.

packName.description: Optional shelf-card display name for the pack. Decorative only: the app folds an absent, null, or whitespace-only value to null rather than failing the manifest (CatalogAdPackManifestSerializer's own posture). The 200-char cap is this catalog's own sanity bound — the app imposes none.

briefs.description: One entry per fictional brand (CatalogAdPackManifestSerializer.MaxBriefsPerPack = 100; an empty array is no pack at all). Order is not significant — the app samples one enabled brief uniformly per generation.

brand.description: The fictional brand this brief is about — the app's upsert key (with the pack slug) and the one field the writer always sees. REQUIRED and non-blank (MaxBrandLength = 200). It must be invented: a real company, product, or trademark here is a hard-ban at review AND fails every spot the app ever writes from it (SPEC F160.3's blocklist refuses the script).

premise.description: The joke engine — what the business is and what is slightly wrong with it, one or two sentences. Optional (null or absent both mean none); ≤ 500 chars (MaxHintLength). Reaches the LLM as a `Premise:` line.

tone.description: How the spot should sound — a few words of register ("shouty local pitchman", "hushed spa whisper"). Optional; ≤ 500 chars. Reaches the LLM as a `Tone:` line.

structure.description: A shape hint for the copy ("two-voice testimonial", "runaway legal disclaimer") layered on the app's own shipped four-beat scaffold. Optional; ≤ 500 chars. Stored and shown on the station's Briefs tab; as of app v5.6.0 the writer does not yet read it (app issue #693).
